intro.title: Unique Paths
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that calculates the number of unique paths a robot can take from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner of a grid, moving only down or right. You will learn the core concept of dynamic programming, which solves complex problems by breaking them into simpler subproblems and storing their results. The main technologies and constructs involved include JavaScript functions, loops, and arrays for storing intermediate results. This beginner-friendly exercise will help you understand how to approach grid-based problems efficiently using fundamental programming techniques.
intro.usecase: The Unique Paths algorithm is essential for navigation and routing systems in real-world applications. It powers route optimization in delivery apps like DoorDash or Uber Eats, calculating the most efficient paths for drivers through grid-like city streets. Game developers use it for AI pathfinding in grid-based games, while robotics engineers apply it to determine optimal movement sequences for automated warehouse robots. This pattern also appears in accessibility tools that calculate navigation routes through structured environments for users with mobility constraints.
